notes.title: Introducing the Trophy Update!
notes.content:
For all you Achievement junkies out there, we know this update will be right up your alley.

After hearing some feedback from players who just couldn't seem to collect certain Achievements, we were able to hunt down a small number of bugs that were preventing those Achievements from unlocking properly.

Those bugs have since been squashed, which means that once you have the latest update, all Steam Achievements for Evasion will be fully unlockable! (If your PSVR buddies ask, we also fixed this issue for PlayStation Trophies.)

The full list of fixes in this latest update are below. Happy Achievement hunting, everyone!

[h1]Update Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing the “Friendly Fire” Trophy / Achievement to not unlock
[*] Fixed bug causing the “The Doctor Is In” Trophy / Achievement to not unlock
[*] Fixed bug causing enemies killed by Surge Attacks to not count towards Trophy / Achievement unlock criteria
[*] Fixed the “Twofer” Trophy / Achievement details to include previously missing text
[/list]

[b]Haven't picked up Evasion yet? It just so happens to be 25% off on Steam at this very moment, so now is your chance![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/683000/Evasion/

notes.title: Celebrating Archiact's 6th Anniversary: A New Lower Price For Evasion!
notes.content:
This April, Archiact is celebrating our 6th anniversary since establishing our studio in 2013. To mark the occasion, we're very excited to announce that we've reduced prices on our developed titles, including Evasion!

[h1]Evasion's new price is now $19.99 on Steam and all other platforms![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/ba2ab06956545cdd7a1b0b0a6598fb694e64422c.jpg[/img]

More than just a temporary reduction or one-time sale, this is our way of saying thanks to the amazing VR community that our dev team has grown up alongside. We hope you enjoy, and come out to join us on the battlefield to take on the Optera!

notes.title: Evasion KILLSTREAK: Time to Dominate the Leaderboards
notes.content:
Win prizes this weekend by dominating the Evasion KILLSTREAK Virtual Competition! ([url=https://www.archiactvr.com/blog/join-us-this-weekend-for-the-killstreak-virtual-competition]More details on Archiact's blog.[/url]) Think you got what is takes to top the Evasion leaderboards? "What leaderboard?" you ask? In our biggest content update since launch, the KILLSTREAK Update unleashes global leaderboards for Evasion on all platforms! This game changer gives you a whole new way to dominate the virtual battlefield and compete head-to-head with your squad.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/5d4afb116a630950169a740a8332e28e13938566.jpg[/img]

Itching to get your score on the board? Killstreaks are the name of the game: rack up a beefy multiplier by outgunning the Optera head-to-head, being the first to bag major kills, and going for every last finishing move you can. Share your videos and screenshots with us on Twitter by tagging us @EvasionVR. Let's see how many points you can rack up against your allies in the Vanguard!

Last but not least, we heard your requests for more locomotion options, and are happy to introduce the all-new "Controller Relative" movement style. Let us know what you think!

Here are the full Update notes:
- Added an all-new arcade scoring system
   - Destroying enemies increases score multipliers
   - Taking damage resets multipliers
- Added leaderboards for each mission and difficulty setting
- Added Controller Relative movement option, accessible in the Quick Menu
        
We'll see you on Faro Colony.  Stay tuned for some of our February community events by following us on Twitter @EvasionVR and don't forget to show off that score - there are leaderboards for every mission and difficulty level!

notes.title: New challenges await the Vanguard in Patch 1.03!
notes.content:
The holidays have come early to Evasion, and we're happy to bring some of the highly requested features for the community and new recruits. Last month we addressed those sore trigger fingers by adding some light auto-fire functionality to the player weapons, and we have more in store starting today.

[h1]INTRODUCING DIFFICULTY SETTINGS[/h1]

While we were excited to hear that Evasion was accessible to all skill levels, we know there were some members of the Vanguard that wanted to take on a new challenge, and some players that wanted options that best fit their skill level.

We've got you covered.

BULLET-BREEZE
In the easiest mode the enemy shots deal less damage to the players. This is a pretty forgiving difficulty and is suitable for a brand new player. Some caution is required however, as a reckless player can still be overwhelmed.

BULLET-HECK
This is a fairly challenging fight. Enemy shots are fired with better accuracy and deal full damage. A skilled player will excel.

BULLET-HELL
As the toughest mode, Bullet-Hell requires players to use every ounce of skill they can muster to survive. Enemies lead their shots to hit players that are moving around, and deal extra damage with every hit. Players need to be careful, keep their shields up, and use more cover.

[h1]WHAT ELSE IS NEW IN PATCH 1.03[/h1]

- Added two new achievements to unlock in Bullet-Hell difficulty
- Some gameplay improvements to the Megatoma and Skimmer behaviors
- Mission tuning to support the new difficulty settings
- Some improvements to how enemies react to player tethers
- Increased the Engineer damage
- Engineer can now do a quick flick and release with the Tether Lash to finish the enemy
- Improved the Surgeon self-heal feature when killing an enemy with the Tether Lash
- Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented achievement progress from being saved (unfortunately any unsaved progress can not be recovered)
- General bug fixing and polishing

Happy holidays from the Evasion team to yours!

notes.title: PC Patch Notes v1.02 (Quality of life improvements - Trigger pull and Surge attack mechanics, and more)
notes.content:
Firstly, we want to thank you for your terrific support and insightful feedback for Evasion since our big launch week. We’ve been super focused on improving the player experience and you can view the full patch notes below. 

Included in this patch are some highly requested quality-of-life improvements to trigger pull mechanics and easier Surge Attack mechanics. If you encounter any issues please feel free to reach out to our support team at evasionsupport@archiactvr.com 

We’ve been absolutely loving the Evasion communities’ ‘Lets Play’ videos and seeing all your awesome moments captured. Keep sharing with us on Twitter @evasionvr to be featured by our community team.

Here's the final Patch Notes for the update:
[list]
[*] Player weapons now shoot more projectiles with a single trigger pull
[*] Striker: Tap for burst-fire. Hold for the laser
[*] Surgeon, Warden, Engineer:
[*] Hold for limited auto-fire, and release to fire the charge shot
[*] Update class choice when Retrying or Advancing to a new Mission
[*] Engineer Tether Slam more reliably destroys impacted enemies
[*] Reduced Fog Opacity and updated mission lighting
[*] Improvements to mission pacing
[*] Surge Attack trigger motion tuned to be more easily triggered
[*] Minor bug fixes and performance enhancements
[/list]
Have fun and stay tuned for our next update soon!
The Evasion Team

notes.title: PC Patch Notes v1.01 (Post Launch Day Fixes)
Evasion Launch Day Has Arrived!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that [i]Evasion[/i] is now available on Steam! Players can now jump into battle and experience the future of VR combat.

A very special thanks to our amazing friends and fans for your incredible support and valuable feedback. [i]Evasion[/i] is a true passion project for our team at Archiact and we cannot wait to team up with you online.

[url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EWRB9WoVIHw[/url]

Powered by Unreal Engine 4 and featuring stunning sci-fi visuals, [i]Evasion[/i] has been designed from the ground up to give players smooth locomotion while still delivering fierce “bullet hell” action. [i]Evasion[/i] has both solo and co-op experiences, and features a full campaign as well as a Survival Mode where players try to outlast endless waves of enemies.
 
Players take on the role of the Vanguard, an elite special ops team that has been dispatched to save a human mining colony from a surprise attack from a lethal insectoid race called the Optera. To save Faro Colony, they will have to use special abilities, tethers, cover systems and whole lot of bullets. 

[h1]Four Killer Classes[/h1]
No matter what your preferred play style, there’s a class for you. Enjoy charging into battle with guns blazing? The heavily armored Warden or the deadly Striker are a perfect fit! Prefer hanging back and providing support for your fellow players? Play as a Surgeon or an Engineer, who can use their Tether Links to heal damage and bolster their allies weapons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/647d06d76af80759be42b7ac5cb0912e34bb087e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Strategic Combat[/h1]
Use your Tether Lash to snatch enemies out of the air and hurl them against buildings, snipe at targets from behind cover, or charge up your blaster and unleash a unique, class-specific Surge Attack. [i]Evasion[/i] offers myriad ways to take down the Optera swarms.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/2fd7244e6a58408782b90640c7279a7023463ffd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Locomotion Evolved[/h1]
No more disembodied hands or teleporting! [i]Evasion[/i] was built from the ground up for free locomotion, with balanced options for all player sensitivities. When paired with the incredibly detailed full body avatars, [i]Evasion[/i] offers total player immersion as the next generation of FPS VR combat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/68e1a807c846b9ab7f6dd4e377e9f440000d5fc6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Visceral, Escalating Action[/h1]
Feel the pressure mount as you fight through swarms of enemies. Turn defeat into victory as you take down fearsome bosses. Face insurmountable odds and emerge a hero. [i]Evasion[/i] is VR experience guaranteed to raise your heart rate. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/670c08a4f869df9d9a40a79c9cbe05252cc9a23a.jpg[/img]

Connect with [i]Evasion[/i] players around the world and stay up to date by joining our community on [url=https://www.facebook.com/evasionvr/]Facebook[/url], @evasionVR on [url=https://twitter.com/EvasionVR]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/EvasionVR]Reddit[/url].

For more information and to receive the latest news, please visit www.evasionvrgame.com
We’ll see you on Faro Colony!

notes.title: The Story of Evasion: A Deep Dive
notes.content:
The conflict with the Optera has a rich history, so we're doing a deep dive into [i]Evasion[/i]'s locations, characters, and story.

[h1]Humanity Takes to the Stars[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/bf7f8617ab66a567e80d018289b93ebabc57837b.jpg[/img]

[i]Evasion[/i] is set in the early 23rd Century. Humans have colonized the spaceways thanks to FTL drives that run on a fuel called [b]chloragen[/b], which has become the galaxy’s most precious commodity. 

The richest source of chloragen is found in space claimed by the [b]Optera[/b], a highly advanced and fiercely xenophobic race. When humans attempted to mine one of their worlds, a terrible war erupted. Millions of lives were lost on both sides before a fragile truce was declared. As a concession, humans were permitted to colonize one of the Optera’s moons. That moon, which the humans christened [b]‘Faro Colony’[/b], became the galaxy’s largest exporter of chloragen.

[h1]Peace is Shattered[/h1]

Now, decades later, the Optera have suddenly and unexpectedly launched an attack on Faro Colony. Your mission is to find out what happened on Faro Colony, and unearth what motivated the Optera to reopen a conflict that nearly brought both species to the brink of extinction. The lives of the over twelve thousand colonists, not to mention the rest of humanity, hang in the balance. Along the way, you’ll liberate outposts, travel deep into a chloragen mine, explore a town built into a crater, and face off against legions of Optera.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/ad9fe2d2bce23426edf5afde80faa44f14559236.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/985499100ce7848de59b26aa19dbf5942e263fca.jpg[/img]

[h1]Enter the Vanguard[/h1]

You play as a member of the [b]Vanguard[/b], an elite special ops team that specialize in breach reconnaissance. Like Navy SEALs of yore, the Vanguard are sent into galactic ‘hot spots’ to reconnoiter and deter threats. The Vanguard have four different classes -- Striker, Surgeon, Warden and Engineer -- each of which have a unique arsenal of weapons and abilities. You will learn more about each of these ‘hero classes’ and their capabilities in future blog posts. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/b184e9023bd173d7d1573ac15a102186f48af2d8.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Lethal Enemy[/h1]

No human has ever set foot on the Optera homeworld, so little is known about the Optera’s true origins. Did they evolve from insects, as their physiology would suggest? Are their exoskeletal structures some kind of cybernetic armor or a robotic vehicle? Their technology is highly advanced: they wield deadly energy weapons, can instantly teleport troops, and are able to launch highly coordinated attacks that don’t seem to rely on verbal communication. But what they want, and why they are so zealous about guarding their territory, remains a mystery to be solved.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/736a021f89e0e1dedeea7de1993e5099e8dcbdfe.jpg[/img]

You will encounter dozens of different kind of Optera as you travel through Faro Colony. From the ubiquitous Paragord to the elusive Skimmer to the fearsome Megatoma, they each pose a unique challenge that will force you to use every weapon and ability in your arsenal to survive. 

[h1]Into the Storm[/h1]

The campaign kicks off with a desperate distress call by [b]Carl Dyson[/b], a mine supervisor. Faro Colony is under attack, he proclaims, before his transmission is jammed. By the time you have boots on the ground, the moon is swarming with Optera, and you have to fight your way to the comm tower in order to discover what happened to Dyson and the other twelve thousand colonists. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/a1ee42db4486321ad5c580773cbabada8ca36af9.jpg[/img]

Your actions are coordinated by [b]A.D.E.L.E.[/b], an [b]A[/b]utonomous [b]D[/b]eep [b]L[/b]earning [b]E[/b]ntity that helps you overcome obstacles throughout the game and provide vital insights as you fight your way deeper into enemy territory. By gaining power ups, you will unlock new weapon capabilities and learn how to wield the powerful equipment at your disposal. And as you progress further in the story, you will solve the mystery of why the Optera attacked, and what it means for the rest of the galaxy.

If you’d like to keep up to date on the latest information about Evasion, check out evasionvrgame.com or get involved via our official [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/evasionVR/]Reddit[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/EvasionVR]Twitter[/url].

See you on Faro Colony!

notes.title: Evasion Enemies Sneak Peek: Who are the Optera?
notes.content:
We had a blast at GDC this year, and it was so awesome to connect with so many VR enthusiasts and gamers over our latest demo build.  Last month we revealed our final two classes, and the crowds of GDC showed us the power of teamwork and class-based synergy!  

But this begs the question: [b]who are the Optera?[/b]

In this update, we'll explore the Optera background, as well as a sneak peek at just a few of the enemy types you'll encounter!

[h1]History[/h1]

The enemies in Evasion are called the Optera and very little is known about their origins. Scientists theorize that they evolved from insects, but it’s unclear whether they wear exo-suits or if the Optera themselves are cybernetic organisms. They use energy weapons, have the ability to instantaneously teleport from location to location, and can propel themselves using anti-gravity technology. Since their attacks are highly coordinated, it’s assumed that are governed by a hive mind or use some non-verbal method of communication.

The main campaign in Evasion takes place on a moon that orbits the Optera homeworld that is rich in a mineral called chloragen, which the humans use to power their ships and colonies. When humans first established a mining operation on that moon, there were some initial skirmishes with the Optera, but a peace accord was struck. 

[h1]Gnats[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/172567219a1879683830b0fd5c0f3d42090d87e7.jpg[/img]

If you’ve ever walked into a hovering cloud of tiny black insects (and probably started sputtering and frantically waving your hands in front of your face), then you’ll recognize these creatures. Gnats are the most ubiquitous enemy in Evasion. They typically travel in small groups, and while they don’t do a ton of damage, they are great at slowly whittling down your health as you focus your energy on the larger enemies. Their movement patterns are erratic and can be hard to predict. But grabbing onto them with your tether and chucking them against a building is extremely satisfying – and they die with a very pleasing scream (courtesy of our talented Sound Designer, Gonzalo Lopez)!

[h1]Paragords[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/5bd5e37244d2b1f40da4ce382e9513c0cfe57266.jpg[/img]

These are the Optera’s foot soldiers. Since there are no other bipedal Optera, it is believed that the Optera create Paragords by using parasites called nematodes to enslave humanoid races and use them in their legions. Paragords lumber into battle and use cover in a human-like way. They will often hide behind cover and lob mortar fire on the player. They fire their weapons in short bursts, machine gun-style, often while moving and changing tactical position. Paragords are dangerous because they’re so different than the rest of the Optera troops.

[h1]Bombers[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/418c853e2b0969a984a667475ec41df300b700c9.jpg[/img]

Bombers are modeled after pill bugs, or woodlice, a type of insect often found in old wooden houses. We thought it was cool how they ball up when threatened, so in our game Bombers roll into battle, plant themselves on the ground and then unfold into a mobile turret that spews blaster fire at the player. As an added bonus, if the players get to close, the Bomber will explode! (Which causes major area-of-effect damage). The best way to defeat a Bomber is to destroy it before it gets too close. As our testers have discovered, you ignore a Bomber at your peril!

Hope you’re excited to tackle the Optera swarm in game, and we’ll be back with more news soon!  Be sure to add Evasion to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/683000/Evasion/]Wishlist[/url], and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/EvasionVR]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/evasionVR/]Reddit[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/evasionvr]Facebook[/url] for the latest news on Evasion.

notes.title: Two new hero classes revealed: Warden and Engineer
notes.content:
It’s been a while!  But we’ve returned with some really exciting updates that we’re proud of, and we hope you can see why!

First thing’s first: We are demoing our brand new build at GDC 2018.  Want to try Evasion?  Want to try a new HTC Vive Pro?  Knock down two birds with one stone with us.  Find us at the Intel Booth, #623 on the South Hall, Expo Floor.  Hope to see all of you there!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/03b7da72daa1fb21d02451471d39f1914ab589b4.jpg[/img]

Last (but of course not in the least), we revealed our final two hero classes this week: The Engineer and The Warden.

We’re stoked on having class-based game play, and excited about bringing everything we love about FPS into virtual reality. Different players have different play styles. Some people prefer to play more aggressively, charging into the fray with guns blazing. Other people having a more tentative play style, prefering to hang back and focus more on supporting their teammates. We wanted to cater to all these preferences and create space in the game for everyone.

Without much further ado, we present:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/3d18b2dc245cba4b6fa82732cf1210f50340a621.png[/img]

[h1]The Warden[/h1]

[i] Our tank. The Warden is ideal for players who like to charge into battle. He can take more damage than any other class and has unique abilities that allow him to get up close and personal with the enemy. [/i] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/ff86914120de8ea2283cd3ceaf30215f784314b9.png[/img]

[h1]The Engineer[/h1]

[i] Our most versatile class. The Engineer can use her tether to grab enemies and whip them around. She can also deal incredible damage and energize teammate’s weapons. [/i] 

The Warden and Engineer join the Surgeon and Striker in our previous demo build that was seen at IEM Oakland and IEM Katowice.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/c5b5b318953070ba52313066b541c71d6f7303b1.png[/img]

[h1]The Surgeon[/h1]

[i] Our combat medic. The Surgeon is the only class that can heal other players, making him invaluable to any team. The surgeon can also turn his abilities against the enemy in deadly ways.  [/i] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31008322/e77ae22018a32bf8ff43376fa3a950a00f26be6f.png[/img]

[h1]The Striker[/h1]

[i] Our fast mover. The Striker is agile and deadly. Her weapons deal awesome damage, and she has unique skills that allow her to bolster teammate’s weapons. [/i] 

Hope you dig what we’ve been cooking up for you behind the scenes, and let us know:

[b]Which class will be the first you try on Evasion? [/b] :)

Hope to see you at GDC!

[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/919171126243473422/07E9A8878DF0469B43655DA0734D0B14DFFD8F87/[/img]
